'''Barrows gloves''' are [[gloves]] that can be purchased for 130,000 [[coins]] (or 104,000 coins after completing the [[Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]]) from the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]] in the [[Lumbridge Castle]] cellar after completing the entire [[Recipe for Disaster]] quest. 

Of all gloves in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', Barrows gloves provide the second highest [[Melee]] offensive bonuses behind the [[ferocious gloves]], the second highest offensive bonuses for [[Ranged]] behind the [[zaryte vambraces]], and the third highest [[Magic]] offensive bonuses behind the [[tormented bracelet]] and [[confliction gauntlets]]. For these reasons they work very well for all types of combat (and especially where multiple attack styles are necessary, such as the [[Dagannoth Kings]] or [[Royal Titans]]), and many players recommend completing Recipe for Disaster and acquiring these gloves as a long-term goal that every beginner should work toward.

While these gloves lack a [[Defence]] requirement, they cannot be acquired at 1 Defence due to the levels required to complete and experience gained from completing the necessary quests to complete Recipe for Disaster. The minimum Defence level a player can have to acquire and equip these gloves is 35 when all quest requirements and experience rewards are calculated, assuming the player did not accept Daero's training at the end of [[Monkey Madness I]]. In limited time modes like [[Deadman Mode]], these gloves can be used by accounts with level 1 Defence after completing Recipe for Disaster via a quest lamp bought with [[Skull points]].

As with all Culinaromancer's gloves, this piece of armour '''cannot''' be made using the [[Smithing]] skill.

Purchasing a pair of Barrows gloves is a requirement for the [[Hard Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]].

When lost in a PvP [[death]], they turn into 78,000 coins.
